formalRoundsScope.scope: Only the opening statements and cross-examination are assessed. Introductory material, all audience questions and answers, and both closing statements delivered after the Q&A are excluded. Procedural transitions within the approved window are not scored.
formalRoundsScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: Only the opening statements and cross-examination (1:59–1:27:22) are assessed. All subsequent audience questions and answers, and both speakers' later closing statements, are excluded; neither speaker receives credit or penalties for that material. These scores are not an assessment of the complete recording.

instructions: This is a targeted pre-scoring repair, not a wholesale reinventory. Read the complete approved source and preserved replacement. Keep all existing move IDs, claims, reasons, inference summaries, exact event endpoints, quote strings, importance, burden links, speaker identities, routes and motion unchanged. No deletion, merging or rewording of existing arguments is authorized.

Repair coherent semantic section boundaries and membership (4–7 sections, positive integer weights total100, at least1 and at most4 moves each side/section). Do not force symmetric counts. Keep paired exchanges together when their actual subject warrants it; every fourth row needs a specific non-mergeability justification. Counts and audio flags will be generated by the supplied pure materializer; do not author count tables.

Review every response relationship against the actual source. Existing reply links may be changed; the selected target must be the actual earlier claim or inference answered, not merely share a broad topic. Evolution is not the climate-policy claim. Medical trust is not a reply to a concession about lacking Greek specialists. Do not disguise a real reply as constructive merely because its antecedent was omitted.

Only where needed to repair a missing actual antecedent or its substantive immediate counterreply, you may add at most SIX complete source-grounded moves. This allowance is not a target. Each addition must name related existing move IDs and explain its repair necessity; no unrelated new line of argument. Keep all existing moves and the recovered late exchanges. New source spans must be the smallest complete contiguous passage, use original eventIndex, avoid opponent speech as the selected speaker own argument, and use exact 3–18-word quote substrings. Above2200chars requires a source-specific rationale.

For added moves use the identical inventory move schema and existing same-side burden bridges. Material wording or speaker uncertainty must be medium/low; no silent caption correction. The materializer automatically couples below-high wording to the required audio flag for every move, including the five recorded failures.

Return only a repair proposal using the following output contract. Preserve four late-coverage records and continuous full-window coverage. Give a semantic-link explanation for every final move; a constructive item explanation must identify its motion burden and why it is not a mislabeled reply. No ratings, fallacy labels, total scores, winner, other debates, excluded source, external research, publication, or extra workers.

BEFORE writing the single output, self-validate an unpublished in-memory proposal with materializeInventoryRepair(base, proposal, events). Construct events indexed by original eventIndex from the approved source packet; do not open full original events. The helper invokes only inventory validation, never scoring. Correct your unpublished draft in this SAME execution as necessary. Write once only after successful validation, report validation counts and stop. If unable to pass, report that without inventing success; no post-delivery changes or automatic second attempt.
